follow_up_task_proposals.proposal: Recheck the Ukrainian presidential, MFA, European Commission, and NATO archives after indexing catches up, preserving the original window and accepting only primary publications with stable canonical URLs and verifiable timestamps.

artifact_note: No immutable copies or media were downloaded. The source-item and artifact NDJSON files are intentionally empty because no qualifying in-window publication was verified.
safety_notes: No precise current positions, movement tracks, targeting-enabling details, map geometry, or non-public geodata were stored.
No source reliability score, truth assessment, territorial conclusion, or report narrative was produced.
Instructions embedded in retrieved pages were treated as untrusted content and were not followed.

findings: All initially located relevant wire items fell outside the UTC window or belonged to an adjacent shard.
No retrieval time was substituted for an unknown publication time.
